units.title: Actual truncated matrix means in the Gaussian column experiment
units.reader_note: Open assumptions and source-ordered steps for the exact experiment, coefficient and adjacent Lean.
units.statement: Every actual truncated matrix is integrable and has the exact common-coefficient mean. The private consumer proves the expectations of the actual unweighted and cosine-weighted sums.
units.formula: Y_i\in L^1(\mu),\qquad \mathbb E_\mu Y_i=\frac ad\bigl(I_r\otimes t_it_i^\top\bigr).
assumptions: Let \(d,q\in\mathbb N\), \(2q+1<d\), and \(r=q+1\). Thus \(d\ge2\), \(r\ge1\), and \(q=0\) is retained.

The original outcome space is \(\Omega=(\mathbb R^d)^r\), with the literal product \(\mu=\gamma_d^{\otimes r}\), where \(\gamma_j=N(0,I_j)\). The actual row is \(\Phi_i(\omega)=(\omega_{1,i},\ldots,\omega_{r,i})\). No row law or mean is supplied by the caller.

Put \(L=2r+3\log(1000d)\), \(\theta_i=(i-\tfrac12)\pi/d\), \(t_i[0]=1\), and \(t_i[k]=\sqrt2\cos(k\theta_i)\) for \(1\le k\le q\). The source physical index is \(i.val+1\); feature indices remain \(k.val\).

The common scalar is fixed by \(a=r^{-1}\int_{\mathbb R^r}\|x\|^2\mathbf1_{\{\|x\|^2\le L\}}\,d\gamma_r(x)\). Its retained-radius integrability belongs to the reused canonical moment proof. The actual row law identifies this same scalar in every physical row; no free per-row coefficient is introduced.

The displayed \(Y_i\) uses its own inclusive local cutoff, inverse-\(d\) scaling, and Gaussian-first paired indices in the Kronecker product. It is an unconditional truncated matrix on the same original \(\mu\); the law is not conditioned on all rows passing.

Matrix expectations are complete Bochner integrals in the actual finite-dimensional Euclidean operator norm. Integrability of every \(Y_i\) and of both actual sums is proved. The source displays sums of expectations; finite integrability and integral exchange internally give the displayed actual-sum expectations. No independence, Gram, moment, integrability, mean, \(\tau\), or condition-number certificate is a premise.

steps.title: Use the same canonical row law and retained radial moment
steps.text: Set up the literal source experiment and cutoff. Reuse the existing truncated-row theorem, whose proof establishes retained-radius and matrix integrability and identifies the coefficient by the radial trace. Reuse the existing actual-row Gaussian pushforward, with measurability and exact standard marginal law as its outputs.
steps.lean:
classical
  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let a : ℝ :=
    (∫ x : E, Set.indicator {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L} (fun y : E => ‖y‖ ^ 2) x
      ∂stdGaussian E) / r
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let ν : Measure E := stdGaussian E
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let N := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let good : Set E := {x | ‖x‖ ^ 2 ≤ L}
  let G : E → M := fun x => Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp x) (WithLp.ofLp x)
  let kept : E → M := good.indicator G
  have moment := FixedSpectrumTruncatedRowMoment.actual_truncated_row_second_moment
    (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change Integrable kept ν ∧ (∫ x, kept x ∂ν) = a • (1 : M) at moment
  have row_law (i : Fin d) : MeasurePreserving (row i) μ ν :=
    FixedSpectrumSourceRowLaw.actual_source_row_marginal_law hq i

steps.title: Transport the genuine row moment to the original experiment
steps.text: The measure-preserving row map pulls canonical integrability back to the actual row. Apply the general integral-map rule with the actual a.e. strong measurability furnished by integrability. No injectivity or measurable embedding of the row map is required. The same pushforward also identifies the retained scalar coefficient under each actual row law.
steps.lean:
have actual_kept_integrable (i : Fin d) :
      Integrable (fun ω => kept (row i ω)) μ :=
    (row_law i).integrable_comp_of_integrable moment.1
  have actual_kept_mean (i : Fin d) :
      (∫ ω, kept (row i ω) ∂μ) = a • (1 : M) := by
    have measurable_on_map : AEStronglyMeasurable kept (Measure.map (row i) μ) := by
      rw [(row_law i).map_eq]
      exact moment.1.aestronglyMeasurable
    have transport := integral_map (row_law i).measurable.aemeasurable measurable_on_map
    rw [(row_law i).map_eq] at transport
    exact transport.symm.trans moment.2

steps.title: Commute the fixed tensor map with expectation
steps.text: For each physical row, form the continuous linear map from r-by-r matrices to paired-index matrices, M maps to inverse-d times M tensor t_i t_i-transpose. Its image of the retained row matrix is exactly the actual Y_i, including the inclusive cutoff. Continuous linear maps preserve integrability and commute with these Bochner integrals, yielding the producer conclusion.
steps.formula: T_i(M)=d^{-1}(M\otimes t_it_i^\top),\qquad Y_i=T_i\circ G_L\circ\Phi_i,\qquad \mathbb E_\mu Y_i=T_i(aI_r).
steps.lean:
let feature : Fin d → M := fun i => Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)
  let tensor : Fin d → M →ₗ[ℝ] N := fun i =>
    (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear : M →ₗ[ℝ] M →ₗ[ℝ] N).flip (feature i)
  let scaled : Fin d → M →L[ℝ] N := fun i => (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • (tensor i).toContinuousLinearMap
  have actual_image (i : Fin d) : Y i = fun ω => scaled i (kept (row i ω)) := by
    funext ω
    change (if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (G (row i ω)) (feature i) else 0) =
        (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (kept (row i ω)) (feature i)
    by_cases hω : ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L
    · simp [hω, kept, good]
    · simp [hω, kept, good]
  change (∀ i : Fin d, Integrable (Y i) μ) ∧
    ∀ i : Fin d, (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) =
      (a / (d : ℝ)) • Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) (feature i)
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · intro i
    rw [actual_image]
    exact (scaled i).integrable_comp (actual_kept_integrable i)
  · intro i
    calc
      (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) = scaled i (∫ ω, kept (row i ω) ∂μ) := by
        rw [actual_image]
        exact (scaled i).integral_comp_comm (actual_kept_integrable i)
      _ = scaled i (a • (1 : M)) := congrArg (scaled i) (actual_kept_mean i)
      _ = a • scaled i (1 : M) := (scaled i).map_smul a (1 : M)
      _ = (a / (d : ℝ)) • Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) (feature i) := by
        change a • ((d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) (feature i)) = _
        simp only [smul_smul, div_eq_mul_inv]

steps.title: Match both source cosine-frame identities
steps.text: The complete private statement and setup use the exact same actual experiment and materially call the new producer. Normalize the two algebraically equal half-grid angle expressions, then apply the existing canonical cosine-frame theorem. Reading its ordinary and diagonal-weighted products entrywise gives both deterministic feature sums, including the constant-feature q=0 case.
steps.lean:
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixMean
import AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity.FixedSpectrumCosineGram

/-! Both actual finite sums are integrable and have the source Ex110 expectations.
The actual-Y producer and exact cosine-frame identities are material inputs;
no law, integrability, Gram, mean or independence certificate is a binder. -/

noncomputable section
open MeasureTheory ProbabilityTheory
open scoped BigOperators Matrix.Norms.L2Operator
set_option autoImplicit false

namespace AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityFixedSpectrumSourceMatrixMean

open AutoSamplingTheory.ExampleCases.GaussianComplexity

private theorem actual_source_truncated_sum_means
    {d q : ℕ} (hq : 2 * q + 1 < d) :
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let a : ℝ :=
    (∫ x : E, Set.indicator {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L} (fun y : E => ‖y‖ ^ 2) x
      ∂stdGaussian E) / r
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Fin d → Fin (q + 1) → ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i : Fin d, Y i ω) μ ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i : Fin d,
      Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i) • Y i ω) μ ∧
    (∫ ω, ∑ i : Fin d, Y i ω ∂μ) =
      a • (1 : Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ) ∧
    (∫ ω, ∑ i : Fin d, Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i) • Y i ω ∂μ) = 0
:= by
  classical
  dsimp only
  let D := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin d)
  let E := EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin (q + 1))
  let Ω := Fin (q + 1) → D
  let μ : Measure Ω := Measure.pi (fun _ : Fin (q + 1) => stdGaussian D)
  let r : ℝ := ((q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ)
  let L : ℝ := 2 * r + 3 * Real.log (1000 * (d : ℝ))
  let a : ℝ :=
    (∫ x : E, Set.indicator {y : E | ‖y‖ ^ 2 ≤ L} (fun y : E => ‖y‖ ^ 2) x
      ∂stdGaussian E) / r
  let θ : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 - 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ)
  let t : Matrix (Fin d) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i k =>
    if k.val = 0 then 1 else Real.sqrt 2 * Real.cos ((k.val : ℝ) * θ i)
  let row : Fin d → Ω → E := fun i ω =>
    WithLp.toLp 2 (fun b : Fin (q + 1) => ω b i)
  let Y : Fin d → Ω →
      Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ := fun i ω =>
    if ‖row i ω‖ ^ 2 ≤ L then
      (d : ℝ)⁻¹ • Matrix.kronecker
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)) (WithLp.ofLp (row i ω)))
        (Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i))
    else 0
  let M := Matrix (Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let N := Matrix (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) (Fin (q + 1) × Fin (q + 1)) ℝ
  let w : Fin d → ℝ := fun i => Real.cos (((2 * q + 1 : ℕ) : ℝ) * θ i)
  let feature : Fin d → M := fun i => Matrix.vecMulVec (t i) (t i)
  let tensor : M →ₗ[ℝ] N :=
    (Matrix.kroneckerBilinear : M →ₗ[ℝ] M →ₗ[ℝ] N) (1 : M)
  let K : Fin d → N := fun i => tensor (feature i)
  have moments := FixedSpectrumSourceMatrixMean.actual_source_truncated_matrix_means
    (d := d) (q := q) hq
  change (∀ i : Fin d, Integrable (Y i) μ) ∧
    (∀ i : Fin d, (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) = (a / (d : ℝ)) • K i) at moments
  have half_grid (i : Fin d) :
      ((i.val : ℝ) + 1 / 2) * Real.pi / (d : ℝ) = θ i := by
    dsimp only [θ]
    ring
  have frame := FixedSpectrumCosineGram.actual_cosine_frame_gram (d := d) (q := q) hq
  dsimp only at frame
  simp_rw [half_grid] at frame
  change t.transpose * t = (d : ℝ) • (1 : M) ∧
    t.transpose * Matrix.diagonal w * t = 0 ∧ _ at frame
  have gram : (∑ i : Fin d, feature i) = (d : ℝ) • (1 : M) := by
    ext j k
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, feature i) j k = ∑ i : Fin d, t i j * t i k :=
        Matrix.sum_apply j k Finset.univ feature
      _ = ((d : ℝ) • (1 : M)) j k := by
        simpa only [Matrix.mul_apply, Matrix.transpose_apply] using
          congrFun (congrFun frame.1 j) k
  have weighted_gram : (∑ i : Fin d, w i • feature i) = 0 := by
    ext j k
    have weighted_entry := congrFun (congrFun frame.2.1 j) k
    change (∑ i : Fin d, (t.transpose * Matrix.diagonal w) j i * t i k) = 0 at weighted_entry
    simp only [Matrix.mul_diagonal, Matrix.transpose_apply] at weighted_entry
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, w i • feature i) j k = ∑ i : Fin d, w i * (t i j * t i k) :=
        Matrix.sum_apply j k Finset.univ (fun i => w i • feature i)
      _ = ∑ i : Fin d, t i j * w i * t i k := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        ring
      _ = (0 : M) j k := weighted_entry

steps.title: Assemble the two sums of actual matrix means
steps.text: The fixed linear tensor map M maps to I_r tensor M carries the two feature sums to dI_(r squared) and zero. Substitute the actual individual means and use the internally derived nonzero physical dimension to cancel d. The result is the source Ex110 pair of sums of expectations, without a supplied Gram or mean certificate.
steps.lean:
have tensor_one : tensor (1 : M) = (1 : N) := by
    change Matrix.kronecker (1 : M) (1 : M) = (1 : N)
    dsimp only [Matrix.kronecker]
    exact Matrix.one_kronecker_one
  have tensor_gram : (∑ i : Fin d, K i) = (d : ℝ) • (1 : N) := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, K i) = tensor (∑ i : Fin d, feature i) := (map_sum tensor _ _).symm
      _ = (d : ℝ) • tensor (1 : M) := by rw [gram, map_smul]
      _ = (d : ℝ) • (1 : N) := by rw [tensor_one]
  have weighted_tensor : (∑ i : Fin d, w i • K i) = 0 := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, w i • K i) = tensor (∑ i : Fin d, w i • feature i) := by
        simp only [map_sum, map_smul]
        rfl
      _ = 0 := by rw [weighted_gram, map_zero]
  have hd : (d : ℝ) ≠ 0 := by exact_mod_cast (show d ≠ 0 by omega)
  have mean_sum : (∑ i : Fin d, ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) = a • (1 : N) := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, ∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ) = (a / (d : ℝ)) • (∑ i : Fin d, K i) := by
        simp_rw [moments.2]
        exact Finset.smul_sum.symm
      _ = a • (1 : N) := by
        rw [tensor_gram, smul_smul, div_mul_cancel₀ a hd]
  have weighted_mean_sum : (∑ i : Fin d, w i • (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ)) = 0 := by
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin d, w i • (∫ ω, Y i ω ∂μ)) =
          (a / (d : ℝ)) • (∑ i : Fin d, w i • K i) := by
        rw [Finset.smul_sum]
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i _
        rw [moments.2 i]
        exact smul_comm _ _ _
      _ = 0 := by rw [weighted_tensor, smul_zero]

steps.title: Integrate the actual finite random sums
steps.text: Individual actual Y integrability gives integrability of each deterministically weighted summand and both finite sums. Exchange the finite sums with the Bochner integral and pull out each fixed cosine scalar. This turns the source sums of expectations into the actual-sum expectations in the private target. Joint independence is not required for this calculation.
steps.lean:
have weighted_integrable (i : Fin d) : Integrable (fun ω => w i • Y i ω) μ :=
    (moments.1 i).smul (w i)
  change Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i : Fin d, Y i ω) μ ∧
    Integrable (fun ω => ∑ i : Fin d, w i • Y i ω) μ ∧
    (∫ ω, ∑ i : Fin d, Y i ω ∂μ) = a • (1 : N) ∧
    (∫ ω, ∑ i : Fin d, w i • Y i ω ∂μ) = 0
  refine ⟨integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => moments.1 i),
    integrable_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => weighted_integrable i), ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => moments.1 i)]
    exact mean_sum
  · rw [integral_finsetSum _ (fun i _ => weighted_integrable i)]
    simp_rw [integral_smul]
    exact weighted_mean_sum

end AutoSamplingTheory.Tests.GaussianComplexityFixedSpectrumSourceMatrixMean
